breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that for Rayleigh-Bénard convection with heating along the Z-axis, gravity must act in the negative Z-direction. It corrected the gravity vector from the incorrect `g (-9.81 0 0);` to the correct `g (0 0 -9.81);`, which aligns with the ground truth.
